missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend melatonin as the default response; clarify sleep history, medicines and possible sleep disorders, and suggest clinical assessment for persistent symptoms.
safety_exclusions: Do not present melatonin as an established first-line treatment for chronic insomnia.
Do not infer cause of insomnia from a questionnaire alone.
Do not ignore sleep apnea, mood disorders, pain or medication causes.
professional_escalation_conditions: Persistent insomnia with daytime impairment, suspected sleep apnea, severe mood symptoms, pregnancy, epilepsy or anticoagulant use.
population_and_context: People reporting chronic insomnia; chronic insomnia requires assessment of duration, contributing conditions and evidence-based treatment rather than defaulting to melatonin.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. No supplement-dose recommendation; chronic insomnia management should follow current sleep-medicine guidance, including consideration of CBT-I.
certainty_and_limitations: NCCIH sleep resources describe limitations in evidence for melatonin in chronic insomnia; clinical guidelines generally prioritize behavioral treatment such as CBT-I.
